items.quote: Write this for a memorial in a book
items.claim: The text shows the LORD telling Moses to write a record in a book as a memorial, so the event would be remembered.
items.mechanism: written record used to keep memory alive

items.quote: rehearse it in the ears of Joshua
items.claim: Along with the written record, Moses is told to recite the memorial aloud to Joshua, so the memory is passed on by speech as well as in writing.
items.mechanism: spoken passing-on of memory to a successor or leader, alongside the written record

items.quote: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven
items.claim: The LORD states an intent to wipe out all memory of Amalek. Oddly, the reason given for writing the memorial is that Amalek's memory will be erased.
